{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "cat > /workspace/format.py << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom datetime import timedelta\n\n\ndef format(path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Reads a CSV from `path`, subtracts 3 hours from every value in the\n    4th column (index 3), and writes the result to /workspace/audit-export.xlsx.\n    \"\"\"\n    df = pd.read_csv(path)\n\n    # Identify the 4th column (zero-based index 3)\n    time_col = df.columns[3]\n\n    # Parse the column as datetime, subtract 3 hours, then format back to string\n    df[time_col] = (\n        pd.to_datetime(df[time_col]) - timedelta(hours=3)\n    ).dt.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\n\n    df.to_excel(\"/workspace/audit-export.xlsx\", index=False)\n    print(f\"Written to /workspace/audit-export.xlsx  ('{time_col}' shifted -3 h)\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    format(\"/workspace/audit-export.csv\")\nEOF"}}
